title: Allow Plasmoids to define toggle actions that will be displayed interactively in the expanded view
line: Notifications and Bluetooth now have an on/off switch right in the expanded System Tray, no need to open them first.
explanation: Widgets in the expanded System Tray could only be opened, so switching Bluetooth or Do Not Disturb needed a click to open the widget and another on its own switch. The only shortcut was middle-clicking the icon, which nobody discovers. Widgets can now register a checkable internal action called "quick toggle"; the tray shows it as a switch at the end of that widget's entry in the expanded view, kept in sync with the action. Notifications registers a "Show notifications" action (off = Do Not Disturb) and Bluetooth registers its existing Enable Bluetooth action.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: show quick toggles in the expanded view

Turning notifications or Bluetooth on and off from the expanded System
Tray meant opening the widget first. Widgets can now set a "quick
toggle" action that the tray shows as a switch, as Notifications does.

BUG: 460125

applet: offer Enable Bluetooth as the System Tray's quick toggle

The System Tray can now show a switch next to widgets in its expanded
view when they set a "quick toggle" internal action. Use the existing
Enable Bluetooth action for it, so Bluetooth can be switched on there.

BUG: 460125

From ca171870ff80e136003e710bd3cbb0a2ca124267 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 23:10:08 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: offer Enable Bluetooth as the System Tray's quick
 toggle

The System Tray can now show a switch next to widgets in its expanded
view when they set a "quick toggle" internal action. Use the existing
Enable Bluetooth action for it, so Bluetooth can be switched on there.

BUG: 460125
---
 src/applet/qml/main.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/applet/qml/main.qml b/src/applet/qml/main.qml
index a9014a1a..69b7bb3d 100644
--- a/src/applet/qml/main.qml
+++ b/src/applet/qml/main.qml
@@ -147,5 +147,6 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     Component.onCompleted: {
         Plasmoid.setInternalAction("configure", configureAction);
+        Plasmoid.setInternalAction("quick toggle", toggleBluetoothAction);
     }
 }
--
